question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the right of E. Only two people sit between F and C. Only three people sit between E and B. D sits to the immediate left of A. How many people sit between A and G when counted from the left of A?
solution: **Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the right of E. Only two people sit between F and C.
